title: Cortex Containerization with Private Fork
objective: Transform Cortex into a containerized application with private GitHub fork, Docker support, Kubernetes deployment, and upstream sync automation

tasks.title: Analyze Cortex structure, dependencies, and configuration requirements
tasks.description: inventory: Comprehensive analysis of Cortex codebase structure. Analyze package.json dependencies, runtime requirements, configuration files, environment variables, volume mount requirements, port mappings, and external service dependencies (API keys, MCP servers). Identify files for .dockerignore. Document current architecture for containerization planning.

tasks.title: Security scan of containerization requirements and secrets management
tasks.description: security: Analyze security requirements for containerized Cortex. Review secrets management strategy (API keys, tokens), Docker security best practices, vulnerability scanning setup, least-privilege user configuration, network security policies, secret injection methods (env vars vs. Docker secrets vs. k8s secrets), and compliance requirements. Generate security recommendations.

tasks.title: Create multi-stage Dockerfile for Cortex
tasks.description: development: Create production-ready multi-stage Dockerfile for Cortex. Stage 1: Build stage with Node.js for dependencies. Stage 2: Runtime stage with minimal image. Include bash runtime for shell scripts, proper user configuration (non-root), health check, labels, and optimization for layer caching. Support both amd64 and arm64 architectures.

tasks.title: Create .dockerignore for optimal build context
tasks.description: development: Create .dockerignore file based on inventory analysis. Exclude node_modules, logs, temporary files, .git, coordination runtime files, test coverage, and other unnecessary files. Optimize for minimal build context size while preserving required configuration files.

tasks.title: Create docker-compose.yml for local development
tasks.description: development: Create comprehensive docker-compose.yml for local development and testing. Include Cortex service with volume mounts for development, environment variable configuration, port mappings, health checks, restart policies, and optional services (dashboard, monitoring). Support both development and production profiles.

tasks.title: Create Kubernetes deployment manifest
tasks.description: development: Create Kubernetes Deployment manifest for Cortex. Include replica configuration, pod template with container spec, resource limits/requests, liveness/readiness probes, volume mounts for persistent data, init containers if needed, and deployment strategy (rolling update).

tasks.title: Create Kubernetes Service manifest
tasks.description: development: Create Kubernetes Service manifest for Cortex. Define service type (ClusterIP/NodePort/LoadBalancer), port mappings, selectors, and optional ingress configuration for external access to dashboard and APIs.

tasks.title: Create Kubernetes ConfigMap manifest
tasks.description: development: Create Kubernetes ConfigMap for Cortex non-sensitive configuration. Include coordination paths, feature flags, system settings, and other configuration that doesn't contain secrets. Design for easy updates without container rebuilds.

tasks.title: Create Kubernetes Secret manifest template
tasks.description: development: Create Kubernetes Secret manifest template for sensitive data (API keys, tokens). Provide template with placeholder values and documentation on proper secret creation using kubectl or external secret managers (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault). Include base64 encoding instructions.
acceptance_criteria: Secret template with all required keys

tasks.title: Create GitHub Actions workflow for Docker builds
tasks.description: cicd: Create comprehensive GitHub Actions workflow for automated Docker image builds. Include multi-stage build, multi-architecture support (amd64, arm64), automated testing, vulnerability scanning (Trivy), image tagging (semver, latest, sha), push to registry (GitHub Container Registry), and automated deployment triggers. Support both PR builds and release builds.

tasks.title: Create private fork setup documentation
tasks.description: development: Create comprehensive documentation for setting up a private fork of Cortex. Include step-by-step instructions for: creating private fork on GitHub, configuring upstream remote, setting up branch protection, configuring secrets/variables, initial fork setup, and verification steps. Must emphasize PRIVATE repository creation.

tasks.title: Create upstream sync automation workflow
tasks.description: cicd: Create GitHub Actions workflow for automated upstream synchronization from ry-ops/cortex to private fork. Include scheduled sync (weekly), conflict detection, automated PR creation for updates, manual trigger option, and notification system. Preserve private fork customizations while pulling upstream changes.

tasks.title: Create build and deployment automation scripts
tasks.description: development: Create helper scripts for local development and deployment. Include: build-docker.sh (local Docker build with tagging), run-docker.sh (local container run with proper config), deploy-k8s.sh (kubectl apply with validation), test-container.sh (container health verification), and cleanup.sh (remove containers/images).
acceptance_criteria: Compatible with both Docker and k8s

tasks.title: Create comprehensive containerization strategy document
tasks.description: development: Create master containerization strategy document. Include: architecture overview, deployment options (Docker Compose vs Kubernetes), configuration management, secrets handling, scaling strategy, monitoring/observability, backup/restore procedures, disaster recovery, upgrade procedures, troubleshooting guide, and best practices. Consolidate all sub-documentation into cohesive guide.

tasks.title: Create container security scanning and hardening guide
tasks.description: security: Create comprehensive container security guide. Include: image scanning procedures (Trivy, Snyk), runtime security (AppArmor/SELinux profiles), network policies, secret rotation procedures, vulnerability remediation workflow, compliance checking, security monitoring, and incident response for containerized environments.

success_criteria: All Docker configuration files created and tested
All Kubernetes manifests created and validated
notes: Maximum parallel execution using MoE routing
Support both Docker Compose and Kubernetes
